recognize_zh: CD3免疫染色下，固有層內幾乎所有浸潤細胞都呈強陽性，將陰性腺體包圍隔開；NK細胞腸病的NK細胞表面CD3陰性，但用多株CD3ε抗體染石蠟切片時會呈細胞質陽性，所以單看此圖不能據以診斷為T細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse strong CD3 staining of the dense lamina propria infiltrate
Positive medium-sized cells encircle and separate negative glands
Staining appears both membranous and cytoplasmic; surface versus cytoplasmic localization cannot be resolved at this power
Minimal intraepithelial CD3-positive cells; no gland destruction
describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry on gastrointestinal mucosa shows diffuse strong staining of a dense infiltrate of medium-sized cells expanding the lamina propria between CD3-negative glands. Intraepithelial positivity is limited, and glands are preserved. Because paraffin CD3 antibodies detect the cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon chain expressed by NK cells, this pattern does not by itself establish T-cell lineage. With CD56 positivity, CD5 negativity, lack of TCR clonality and EBER negativity, the findings support NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: MEITL shows CD3-positive cells with striking epitheliotropism and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas this infiltrate spares the epithelium and would be TCR non-clonal.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD expresses surface CD3 with CD5 and CD4 or CD8, lacks CD56 and shows clonal TCR.
ENKTL shares cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon expression but is EBER-positive with necrosis and angiodestruction.
